title: Professional summary
bodyPrimary:
Full-stack Java / Angular developer with 6 years of experience, specialized in designing high-performance web applications and processing large data volumes.

My expertise covers the full development lifecycle, from back-end architecture with Java / Spring (Boot, Batch, Integration, Web / WebFlux) to building modern Angular user interfaces.
bodyExpanded:
Thanks to my specialization in Spring Batch, I regularly work on complex integration, migration, and asynchronous processing challenges involving large-scale data flows.

🛠 Technical skills & keywords

  • Back-end: Java, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, Spring Integration, REST APIs, microservices, JPA / Hibernate
  • Front-end: JavaScript, Angular, TypeScript, Leaflet, HTML5, CSS3 / SASS, SPA
  • Databases: SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, data modeling
  • Environment & practices: Git, CI/CD, Docker, unit testing (JUnit), Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe)

💡 Throughout my assignments, I have built strong expertise in application modernization and continuous improvement of existing systems.
